memory_candidates.content: A hand-typed count repeated across N prose/doc sites (e.g. 'the allowlist holds 7 lines') drifts the moment the underlying measured set changes by one, even though the mechanical check itself (frozenset equality) stays correct. When fixing such a drift, re-grep every candidate site with a broad pattern (e.g. 'seven|\b7\b|7-line') across ALL in-scope files both before and after editing, and explicitly classify every surviving hit as in-scope-fixed or deliberately-forbidden (dated snapshot, unrelated numeral) rather than assuming the inventory is complete.
